title: Cap multi-document payloads and enforce the stdio transport size limit
description: In the same checkout, cap collection-shaped payloads: add maxItems and a total-size bound to the documents array in src/tools/mongodb/create/insertMany.ts (lines 22-26); make the stdio payload limit advertised in src/transports/constants.ts (lines 15-17, 50 MiB) actually enforced on the stdio path, rejecting oversized framed messages before any tool handler runs, keeping the limit configurable with the 50 MiB default; leave the HTTP transport body limit (default 100 KiB) unchanged. Constraints: the vitest gate is blocking; no deployment windows or change freeze are configured in sdlc/policy.json, so only the dev -> qa -> prod environmentsOrder, one approval and the documented rollback apply.
acceptanceCriteria: The insertMany documents schema in src/tools/mongodb/create/insertMany.ts has maxItems set; a call above the cap fails schema validation before the MongoDB driver is invoked

A stdio message larger than the configured limit (default 50 MiB) is rejected by the transport before any tool handler runs, and the enforcement code references the constant in src/transports/constants.ts
The HTTP transport body limit is unchanged and the full vitest run exits 0

verificationMethod.description: Run the gateway from the local checkout over stdio and send (a) a tool-call payload above the configured limit and (b) an insert-many call above the documents cap: expected result - both are rejected with a schema or transport validation error before reaching the MongoDB driver, and a valid small call succeeds.

rootCause.description: The insert-many tool left its documents array without maxItems and the stdio transport advertised a 50 MiB payload limit as informational only with no enforcement code, so oversized payloads reached the MongoDB driver and the filesystem.
